name: OTA API and worker
summary: The NestJS 11 data plane of every OTA: the booking API on 127.0.0.1:4000 (storefront, third-party keys and the OTA admin's console calls), Stripe webhooks, and a BullMQ worker (health on 4001) for provisioning, ticketing, sync, reconciliation, e-mails, PDFs and purges; one PostgreSQL schema per OTA reached only through tenantTx.
audience: Travellers (through the storefront or a third-party frontend)
Third-party developers (pk_/sk_ keys, the JS SDK)
stack: NestJS 11 on Express 5 (helmet, cookie-parser, nestjs-cls, nestjs-pino)
Ajv 8 OpenAPI validation of every request
nodemailer + Handlebars (safe subset) e-mail, pdfmake PDFs

local.notes: Builds once, then runs tsc --watch, the API (dist/main.js, 127.0.0.1:4000) and the worker (dist/worker.js, health 127.0.0.1:4001). Needs PostgreSQL, Redis, Mailpit, the Amadeus stub (pnpm stub:amadeus, :4900), the key files of pnpm dev:keys, ota/backend/.env.local from .env.example, and the platform dev:seed followed by this package's dev:seed (demo OTA tenant_demo and, since X-055, the second test OTA tenant_demoown on its own Amadeus test connection; four test keys printed once). Try: curl -H 'X-Api-Key: pk_test_…' http://localhost:4000/v1/storefront.

production.host: api.ota.example.com (and /api/* on every storefront host, e.g. demo.ota.example.com)

talksTo.how: Serves it: Caddy proxies /api/* of every storefront host to 127.0.0.1:4000 with X-Velexis-Edge and X-Velexis-Host (edge caller, cookie sessions, CSRF)
Serves it: server-side calls on loopback with OTA_ADMIN_SERVICE_KEY, the staff bearer token, X-Velexis-Environment and the end-user IP/agent headers (console scope)
Serves it: @velexis/ota-sdk wraps the operations (x-sdk-method), with pk_/sk_ keys or cookies

No HTTP: reads platform tables read-only (cached 60 s, vx:invalidate), consumes ota-tenant-ops, produces platform-tenant-events, redeems ptk:* portal tokens, reads staffdeny:acct:*, writes apikey:used:*
systemd units velexis-ota-api and velexis-ota-worker; Caddy edge; env files /etc/velexis/ota-backend.env and ota-worker.env; deploy runs the tenant migration fan-out and tenants:report-migrations
Amadeus stub (tools/amadeus-stub, :4900) in development, CI and e2e; e2e harness starts the built API and worker

data: tenant_<key>.* (42 tables of the tenant baseline + storefront_assets, storefront_pages)

tenant_<key>.bookings, booking_associated_records, booking_travelers, booking_contacts, booking_segments, booking_tickets, booking_ancillaries, booking_remarks, booking_documents, booking_access_tokens, booking_events
tenant_<key>.customers, customer_identities, customer_sessions, customer_password_resets, customer_preferences, customer_consents, customer_data_exports, saved_travelers, saved_traveler_documents
tenant_<key>.storefront_settings, storefront_assets, storefront_pages, markup_rules, fee_rules, notification_templates
tenant_<key>.notifications, supplier_requests, queue_snapshots, staff_actions, idempotency_keys, schema_migrations
reference.* (airports, airlines, countries, currencies; read only)
platform.tenants, tenant_domains, api_keys, tenant_memberships, accounts, supplier_connections, amadeus_accounts, amadeus_offices, payment_provider_connections, subscriptions, plans (read only)

Redis: tenant:*, tenantkey:*, host:*, apikey:*, member:*, conn:*, amadeus:token|tokenlock|badcred:*, rl:amadeus:*, rl:ota_*, t:<tenantId>:<env>:(sf|pages|search|cxq|ac|authfail|cust):*, staffsess:*, staffdeny:*, ptk:*, apikey:used:*
BullMQ (prefix vx): ota-tenant-ops, platform-tenant-events, ota-stripe-events, ota-payments, ota-bookings, ota-ticketing, ota-notifications, ota-documents, ota-maintenance

roles.name: Visitor (no identity)
roles.can: Storefront bootstrap, reference data, search, offers, upsell, price, open a guest checkout, pay and complete

roles.name: Guest (booking token)
roles.can: One booking: read, documents, events, contact changes, cancellation quote and cancel (X-Booking-Token or __Host-vx_bt)

roles.name: Customer (session)
roles.can: Account, My trips (bookings.list), every booking of the account, password change, account deletion

roles.name: owner / admin (staff)
roles.can: Every console permission, including settings:write, payments:refund, amadeus:write and allowUnpaid issuance; live environment of a live OTA

roles.name: agent (staff)
roles.can: Bookings read/write/issue/cancel, customers, queues, supplier log, raw Amadeus reads, payments read/capture, settings read; live allowed

roles.name: finance (staff)
roles.can: Bookings and customers read, supplier log, payments read/capture/refund, settings read; live allowed

roles.name: viewer (staff)
roles.can: Bookings, customers, payments and settings read only; test environment only

roles.name: Secret key sk_ (storefront / console / console:automation)
roles.can: Customer scope server-side; console scope with a staff token; or key-only console calls limited to the key's permissions (X-Velexis-Scope: console)

roles.name: Stripe
roles.can: POST /webhooks/stripe/** with a valid signature only
